verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for an agentic-commerce platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a Stripe-hosted service: Stripe routes checkout calls, settles payments to the Stripe balance, and runs the hosted MCP endpoint. The open ACP/MPP specs, the open-source Link CLI client, and seller-built checkout endpoints are protocols, clients or integration pieces, not a self-hostable deployment of the core product, so they earn no credit.
